create.name: Manoj Dias
create.bio:
Manoj Dias is a meditation teacher and writer who began his teaching life in Australia, where he co-founded A—SPACE, a drop-in meditation studio offering several disciplines under one roof. He later moved to the United States and co-founded Open, which started as a mindfulness studio in Venice, California, and grew into a meditation and breathwork app. His grounding is in Buddhist meditation and secular mindfulness, studied over almost twenty years with teachers including Tsoknyi Rinpoche, Joseph Goldstein and Dr. Miles Neale, together with more than 500 hours of yoga training, including study with the yoga teacher Maty Ezraty.

His teaching weaves breath, movement and somatic awareness into a practice meant for ordinary, busy lives rather than retreat from them. He has led sessions for companies, schools, sports teams and cultural institutions, has taught weekend programmes at Esalen in Big Sur, and wrote Still, Together, an illustrated book about meditation and connection. He now runs gentle—noise, a publication and YouTube channel exploring contemplative practice in today's culture through essays, conversations and guided meditations, and lives partly in Los Angeles and partly in New York. On Insight Timer he offers guided meditations and a ten-day course on relationships.

books.title: Still Together: Connection through meditation
books.author: Manoj Dias
books.description: A book about meditation as a way back to connection with ourselves and other people, credited to Manoj alongside Sacree Frangine. It was published by Hardie Grant in 2021.

courses.title: Creating Conscious Relationships
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course that brings mindfulness and Buddhist psychology to love and close relationships, from where our beliefs about love come from to listening, compassion and coping with change. Each day pairs a short talk with a reflection or meditation.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: gentle—noise paid subscription
courses.description: The paid tier of his publication adds longer teaching essays on contemplative practice in daily life, guest essays, early podcast episodes, first access to events and a members' chat. He invites people who can't afford it to write to him.

free_resources.title: Manoj Dias on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His guided meditations, including loving-kindness, morning and breath practices, plus a ten-day relationships course for members. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: The Brief from gentle—noise
free_resources.description: His free weekly newsletter, built around a cultural observation, one practice to try straight away and a recommendation for listening.
